FIX GITHUB 401 NOW — VERIFY, REPLACE, REBIND, RESTART, AND PROVE

CURRENT FAILURE

Credential:
GITHUB_TOKEN

Observed result:
HTTP 401 Unauthorized
Bad credentials

This blocks:

- GitHub repository write
- Commit push
- GitHub Actions trigger
- Full autonomous code-to-production deployment

Do not request every credential again.

Fix only the GitHub authentication failure.

==================================================
1. VERIFY THE EXACT TOKEN LOCATION
==================================================

Audit all possible GITHUB_TOKEN locations:

- Render API service environment
- Render worker service environment
- Render environment groups
- GitHub Actions secrets
- local .env files
- deployment scripts
- IVX Variables module
- stale duplicate variables

Return:

- Variable name
- Service/environment
- PRESENT / MISSING
- Loaded at startup
- Last verified
- Current HTTP result
- Active or stale

Never expose the value.

==================================================
2. VERIFY THE CORRECT SERVICES
==================================================

The GitHub token must be available to:

- ivx-senior-dev-01 worker
- API service only if the API directly calls GitHub

It does not need to be added to unrelated frontend services.

Verify which code reads:

process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN

or equivalent.

Return exact file and function.

==================================================
3. OWNER CREATES A NEW FINE-GRAINED TOKEN
==================================================

Create a new GitHub fine-grained personal access token for:

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Required permissions only:

- Contents: Read and write
- Actions: Read and write, only if IVX triggers or reads workflow runs
- Workflows: Write only if IVX modifies workflow files
- Metadata: Read

Do not grant access to every repository.

Do not paste the new token into Rork chat.

==================================================
4. SAVE THE TOKEN IN RENDER
==================================================

In Render, update:

GITHUB_TOKEN

on:

- ivx-senior-dev-01
- ivx-holdings-platform only if that service needs GitHub access

Use the encrypted Environment section.

Save the changes.

Restart or redeploy each affected service so the new token loads at startup.

==================================================
5. REMOVE STALE TOKEN COPIES
==================================================

After the new token is verified:

- remove expired duplicates
- remove wrong variable names
- remove old environment-group copies
- remove any token stored in local files
- remove any token stored in scripts
- remove any token stored in chat/history

There must be one approved source of truth.

==================================================
6. VERIFY GITHUB AUTHENTICATION
==================================================

Run safe API checks from the worker runtime.

Required results:

- GitHub authentication: HTTP 200
- Repository metadata read: PASS
- Branch main read: PASS
- Contents write permission: PASS
- Workflow read: PASS
- Workflow trigger: PASS, if required

Return:

- Credential status
- HTTP status
- Repository
- Branch
- Read permission
- Write permission
- Actions permission
- Last verified timestamp

Do not print the token.

==================================================
7. VERIFY REPOSITORY TARGET
==================================================

Confirm the worker targets:

@[github:https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fibb142%2Fivx-holdings-platform:GitHub Sync - ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform]

Not:

ibb142/IVXHOLDING-

Not the old rork-global-real-estate-invest name.

Return:

- Git remote origin
- Repository owner
- Repository name
- Branch
- HEAD SHA

==================================================
8. RUN A SAFE WRITE TEST
==================================================

Do not modify production code for this test.

Use one safe method:

- create and delete a temporary test branch
or
- verify write permission through the GitHub API without merging
or
- push an approved no-op metadata commit if necessary

Required result:

GitHub write access: PASS

Clean up the temporary branch or test artifact afterward.

==================================================
9. VERIFY WORKFLOW ACCESS
==================================================

Trigger or read the real IVX CI workflow:

.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml

Return:

- Workflow run ID
- Commit SHA
- Trigger result
- Final status

If the workflow cannot be triggered, return the exact GitHub API error and missing permission.

==================================================
10. RESTART AND VERIFY PERSISTENCE
==================================================

Restart:

- ivx-senior-dev-01
- API service if it uses GitHub

Then verify again:

- Token loaded at startup
- GitHub auth HTTP 200
- Repository read PASS
- Repository write PASS
- Workflow access PASS

Required result:

The credential survives restart and redeploy.

==================================================
11. COMPLETE AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After GitHub authentication passes, execute:

OWNER APPROVAL
→ WORKER
→ GITHUB PUSH
→ GITHUB ACTIONS
→ BUILD
→ RENDER DEPLOY
→ /HEALTH
→ /VERSION
→ PROOF LEDGER
→ REPLAY REJECTION

Return:

- Authorization ID
- Job ID
- GitHub Actions run ID
- Approved SHA
- Executed SHA
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- /health result
- /version result
- Proof ledger ID
- Replay result

==================================================
FINAL PASS CONDITIONS
==================================================

GITHUB 401 is fixed only when:

- New token authenticates with HTTP 200
- Correct repository is targeted
- Read access passes
- Write access passes
- Workflow access passes
- Token is loaded after restart
- Autonomous worker completes the GitHub stage
- Full autonomous deployment completes

FINAL STATUS

GITHUB_TOKEN:
PASS / FAIL

GITHUB AUTH:
HTTP 200 / HTTP 401

GITHUB READ:
PASS / FAIL

GITHUB WRITE:
PASS / FAIL

GITHUB ACTIONS:
PASS / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL
